(Currently Amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over __at least a portion of__ the entire carrier; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over __at least a portion of__ the entire carrier.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over __at least a portion of__ the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over __at least a portion of__ the entire carrier.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, further comprising, for a second one of the symbols, allocating __a significant portion of__ the subcarriers to the second broadcast channel.

(Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over __at least a portion of__ the entire carrier, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

(Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over __at least a portion of__ the entire carrier.

(Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over __at least a portion of__ the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.
